about_the_game:
TicTacBlow is a modern take on classic tic-tac-toe (noughts and crosses, X's and O's). TicTacBlow is the familiar, family-friendly, turn-based, territory capture game we all played as children, but with new gameplay mechanics that provide additional choices and create fresh opportunities for clever strategies and extended play.

  • Build settlements to capture territory.

  • Form squads (e.g. 3-in-a-row) to meet board completion requirements.

POWERFUL TOOLS

  • Spend resources to gain powerful weapons and tools.

  • Attack enemy settlements.

  • Mine the field to prevent enemy advancement.

  • Acquire the ultimate weapon: *NUKES* for dramatic reversals.

PLAY CARDS

  • A deck of unique cards adds elements of luck and strategy.

    • Collect resources.

    • Activate power-up.

    • Steal, sabotage, and destroy the enemy.

  • Hold cards in your hand until the timing is just right!

  • Play multiple cards in a single turn for combined effects.

TRADE

  • Trade resources at the market.

  • Optimize your inventory to unlock your own unique strategy.

  • Different board biomes offer varying resource prospects.

EXTEND

  • Extend the fun with multiple boards in a single game.

  • Inventory and score accumulate across all boards.

  • Play board sizes ranging from 3x3 all the way to 10x10.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS

  • Local: two players on the same display.

  • Online: two players through the cloud.

  • LAN: Host and connect on local LAN networks.

  • Server: Run your own server for private gaming.
